(()=>{let n=document.querySelector('textarea[placeholder="Ask anything about your project…"]');if(n)return 'composer already visible';const b=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x=>/live assistant/i.test(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')||x.textContent.trim()==='Live assistant');if(!b)throw Error('NO ASSISTANT TOGGLE');b.click();return 'clicked assistant toggle';})()

window.__POLL={ready:false,entries:null,busy:null,error:null,ticks:0};window.__POLLER=setInterval(async()=>{try{const s=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');const h=await import('/src/studio/assistant/chatHistory.ts');const j=s.useStudio.getState().job;const a=await h.readChatArchive(j.id);const th=(a&&a.threads)||[];const n=th.reduce((x,t)=>x+((t.entries||[]).length),0);const active=th.find(t=>t.id===(a&&a.activeId))||th[th.length-1];window.__POLL.entries=n;window.__POLL.busy=active?!!active.busy:null;window.__POLL.error=active?(active.error||null):null;window.__POLL.ticks++;if(window.__BASE!==undefined&&n>=window.__BASE+2&&active&&active.busy===false)window.__POLL.ready=true;if(active&&active.error)window.__POLL.ready=true;}catch(e){window.__POLL.lastErr=String(e&&e.message||e);}},1000);'poller installed'

(async()=>{const s=await import('/src/studio/store.ts');const h=await import('/src/studio/assistant/chatHistory.ts');const j=s.useStudio.getState().job;const a=await h.readChatArchive(j.id);const n=((a&&a.threads)||[]).reduce((x,t)=>x+((t.entries||[]).length),0);window.__BASE=n;return JSON.stringify({jobId:j.id,base:n});})()
